name: Economy
short: Global LWD$ economy with claims, perks, a market, casino games and API access.
description: Global LWD$ balances with a /eco button panel, one /claim for every ready reward with a daily streak, /pay with a configurable transfer tax, an interactive server shop with inventory and redeem codes, money sinks (profile titles, badges and colours, personal and rented roles with upkeep, claim and XP boosters, streak savers, rain, bounties, auctions, paid shoutouts and paid pins, an optional casino rake and wealth tax), virtual-currency casino games, the publicly verifiable LWDMillions lottery, the Nightlife game, settings in the /control panel, an internal cog API and an optional token-protected HTTP API.
author: itsneufox
install_msg: Economy loaded! Run `[p]slash enablecog Economy` and `[p]slash sync` if slash commands are not synced. Members start with `/eco`, `/claim`, `/pay`, `/shop`, `/casino` and `/nightlife`. Settings, taxes and sink prices are in `/control` (Control cog); `[p]ecoadmin` covers balance adjustments, shop items, rentable roles, API tokens and forced lottery draws.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, global LWD$ balances, claim timestamps, LWDMillions ticket selections and recent winner summaries, LWDMillions announcement channel IDs, server shop items, inventory quantities, one-time redeem codes for in-game item fulfillment, code gift metadata, shop channel/message IDs, economy log channel IDs, Nightlife game inventories, stamina and cooldown timestamps, simulated disease and diagnosis state (not real health information), recovery deadlines and reasons, unpaid game hospital bills and hospital visit counts, encounter totals, satisfaction and spending totals, server Nightlife disable settings, and a capped transaction ledger containing user IDs, guild IDs, amounts, reasons, actor IDs, and timestamps, daily claim streaks, booster and streak saver holdings, per-server profile titles, badges and colours, personal and rented role IDs with their renewal deadlines, bounties and auctions with poster, funder, seller and bidder IDs, paid pin message IDs and deadlines, and, in memory only, which members recently chatted in a channel for rain.
